responsibility: Provides IBM XL-compatibility wrappers for S/390 hardware transactional memory intrinsics on top of GCC builtins, exposing __TM_* entry points for begin/end/abort, nontransactional store, nesting depth, and abort diagnostics. It consumes the __htm_tdb structure from htmintrin.h and translates XL-style API expectations into GCC’s __builtin_tbegin/__builtin_tend/__builtin_tabort and related HTM helpers.
